name: Forever Inside an If-Block
hint: The finder detects an endless loop nested in a conditional that has code after the conditional or another reachable continuation. Once entered, the endless loop never finishes, so the continuation and any later blocks remain unreachable.
instruction: Restructure the conditional and loop so the branch can finish, or replace the endless loop with a loop that has a reliable termination condition.

examples.label: Error
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
if <(1) = (1)> then
forever
move (10) steps
end
end
move (10) steps
